name: The bloodfalls (station 6): the ice belt's southern edge at 5.4 km at the head of Qol Ḍrāi, the iron brine out of the ice cliff rusting red as it falls, red-stained icicles, rust terraces, the red pool, the blood river leaving down its valley with the first riverweed; the Red Gill 11 km north-west, the Vale of Xanadu 3.7 km below
